scientific_integrity: All mathematical universal claims are supported by the written derivation, with directly executed finite checks as reproducibility evidence rather than as a proof. Priority is subject to independent confirmation. No independent audit or validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Noiseless scalar strictly convex quadratic; fixed steps and the analytic soft-sign update only. Stability is local, the prime-two classification is exact but higher periods and global basins are not classified. Critical decay is claimed only for nontrivial local center-manifold orbits. The practical Newton-Schulz polynomial is a different method.
title: Sharp flip threshold and unique attracting two-cycle for scalar Soft Muon
